name: MK43U_ER_Foam_Environment_v0_1
purpose: Defines the first MK43 Ultra ER foam environment artifact. The environment accepts manifolds, contains static Pipeline 1 and Pipeline 2 domain rules, and inherits the ER foam tile as its lowest continuity substrate.

architecture.pipeline_1: static domain rule sequence / topology preservation path
architecture.pipeline_2: static domain rule sequence / interaction and closure path
architecture.manifold_inputs: external recursive topology objects accepted by the environment
architecture.growth_rule: The environment expands according to manifold occupancy, adjacency demand, and recursive interaction pressure. The pipelines do not grow; they remain domain laws.

core_statement: The environment inherits the ER foam tile, contains Pipeline 1 and Pipeline 2, and accepts one or more manifolds for propagation through T0→R7 domain transitions.

non_programmatic_definition.interpretation: This is a conceptual/environmental substrate package, not an instruction to treat MK43U as an ordinary computer program.

coupling_law: ER foam redistributes through dot-notation substrate law
manifold propagates through the next domain

domain_model.T5: persistence thickening / temporal continuity emergence threshold
